items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Bud worked for me several times, as a tenor man and an alto man, both.

ctx.x: That looks like Bud Shank in the saxophone section.
Yeah, it probably is him. Bud worked for me several times, as a tenor man and an alto man, both.

He's sure good. Okay. Then there's Charlie Barnet and His Orchestra, 1948, 11 minutes, one of the Thrills of Music Series, featuring the orchestra in a program of music which includes, "Pompton Turnpike," "Stormy Weather," and "Civilization." It doesn't say for whom.
